title: Orbit: end-to-end model intake, conversion, validation, and pinflow
creator: Aisha Varma
description: Build 'Orbit' — a robust, auditable pipeline that performs end-to-end onboarding for community/open-source LLM weights: intake, metadata normalization, license and signature validation, deterministic conversion to runtime bundles, functional validation, micro-bench profiling and automatic pinning to the model catalog. This ticket implements the core pipeline glue and orchestration for automated model admission and pinflow so downstream systems (catalog, runtime, console) can rely on a single canonical artifact and a published performance profile. Scope focuses on non-enterprise open models (HF/hub snapshots, S3 URIs) and completes the conversion/verification/pend-publish path required for safe serving.
acceptance_criteria: Given an HF model snapshot URL, the pipeline ingests and stores the original weight artifact with provenance metadata in artifact-store
Conversion produces a runtime-compatible bundle (.rbundle) and associated KV-cache-compatible metadata within CI reproducibly (same SHA256 across repeated runs)
Automated license and signature checks run; any model failing policy blocks pinning and creates an incident ticket
Functional validation harness passes: sample prompts generate outputs within expected token/latency bounds
Microbench profiling publishes a perf profile (latency/throughput/peak-memory) to the model-catalog service and attaches quantization recommendations
A pin (catalog entry) is created with version, hardware-compatibility tags, and rollback metadata; pinning can be reverted by the catalog-admin role
Audit logs for each step are emitted to our audit-sink and surfaced in the console for the onboarding event
validation_checklist: SHA256 + size match between source and stored artifact
License SPDX detection and allowlist check
Provenance fields populated (source URL, retrieved_at, retriever)
Conversion idempotency: repeated conversion yields identical rbundle SHA
Unit inference smoke test (<=500ms p50 on ci-small) passes
Profiling harness completes with sane memory values and produces perf.yaml
